headline: Weathered Expanse Fiercest Yet as Mooring County Flares Anew
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse has grown hotter still since our last edition: forty base actions crowd the day's ledger, with Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk the most fought-over grounds, hourly losses on both sides counted in the hundreds, and the latest report filed shortly before press time. The Stlican Shelf and the Nevish Line likewise sent word as late as 15:10, Fort Hoarfrost, Breaker Town and Blackcoat Way leading their lists, the Shelf now showing two posts demolished among its nine. Callahan's Passage has logged no fresh base events since 11:20, yet its casualty returns climb past six hundred the hour for each side. Linn Mercy, by contrast, has gone markedly quieter, its hourly toll falling from the hundreds to double figures. A new flare is reported in Mooring County, where losses standing near single figures an hour a day ago now run into the hundreds, and The Wind Hills changed hands once. Stonecradle has been still since mid-morning, though its returns accelerate. Elsewhere the maps rest in colonial or warden keeping with little to report. It is day 455 of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
